cases.sql: WITH __facts AS (SELECT "InvoiceLineId", "InvoiceId", "TrackId", "UnitPrice", "Quantity" FROM "InvoiceLine"), __grouped AS (SELECT t2."Country" AS "customer_country", COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT t0."InvoiceId"), 0) AS "invoice_count" FROM __facts t0 LEFT JOIN "Invoice" t1 ON t0."InvoiceId" COLLATE BINARY = t1."InvoiceId" COLLATE BINARY LEFT JOIN "Customer" t2 ON t1."CustomerId" COLLATE BINARY = t2."CustomerId" COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY t2."Country") SELECT "customer_country", "invoice_count" FROM __grouped ORDER BY "invoice_count" DESC, "customer_country" ASC LIMIT :result_limit

cases.question: Units sold by month in 2013
cases.sql: WITH __facts AS (SELECT "InvoiceLineId", "InvoiceId", "TrackId", "UnitPrice", "Quantity" FROM "InvoiceLine"), __grouped AS (SELECT substr(t1."InvoiceDate", 1, 7) AS "month", COALESCE(SUM(t0."Quantity"), 0) AS "units_sold" FROM __facts t0 LEFT JOIN "Invoice" t1 ON t0."InvoiceId" COLLATE BINARY = t1."InvoiceId" COLLATE BINARY WHERE substr(t1."InvoiceDate", 1, 10) >= :date_from AND substr(t1."InvoiceDate", 1, 10) <= :date_to GROUP BY substr(t1."InvoiceDate", 1, 7)) SELECT "month", "units_sold" FROM __grouped ORDER BY "month" ASC LIMIT :result_limit
